questions.learningObjective: spot the strict-inequality bug in a binary search loop
questions.stem: After a late delivery, a clerk's binary search uses while (lo < hi) and reports tag 40 missing from int[] data = {40}; even though it sits in the only slot. What is the fault?

options.text: The loop must allow lo == hi so the final candidate is checked
